breakdown.description: Both the central-crack and surface-crack formulas are supplied for the same calculation; use the central-crack form σ_f = sqrt(2Eγ_s / (πa)); the setup gives two competing Griffith relations without a single geometry choice.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification exclusively uses the central-crack formula σ_f = sqrt(2 * E * γ_s / (π * a)) and makes no mention of the surface-crack formula σ_f = sqrt(Eγ_s / (πa)). This correctly resolves the inconsistency by selecting a single geometry (central crack) and eliminating the competing formula, matching the ground truth prompt.
